description: This file implements a Stripe payment service class with methods for creating, collecting, charging, refunding, and deleting payments, as well as handling post-payment actions. It integrates with Stripe API, Prisma ORM, and project-specific utilities.

classes.name: StripePaymentService
classes.description: Implements payment processing using Stripe, including creating charges, collecting card info, charging, refunding, and deleting payments, with support for metadata and error handling.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new payment intent in Stripe for a booking, supporting different payment options.

methods.name: collectCard
methods.description: Collects card details and creates a setup intent for future payments.

methods.name: chargeCard
methods.description: Charges a stored payment method for a booking.

methods.name: afterPayment
methods.description: Schedules an email notification after payment completion.

methods.name: deletePayment
methods.description: Cancels and expires a payment in Stripe.

methods.name: isSetupAlready
methods.description: Checks if Stripe credentials are configured.
